concept: Editorial Future & Swiss Minimalist. An attractive, 'Godly' level modern e-commerce that breaks the generic layout. It bridges high-end fashion editorial layouts with precise, high-density dashboard utility.

headings.usage: H1-H4. High contrast, tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
headings.notes: Never use Inter for headings. Keep headings left-aligned unless specific balance demands center.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, button text. Clean, readable and geometric.
body.notes: Use loose line height (leading-relaxed) for body text.

colors.notes: No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors. Tint neutral greys slightly with blue or orange.

layouts.storefront_home: MODE A: TETRIS GRID. Asymmetrical grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12), large hero image spanning 8 cols, 4 cols for text and secondary imagery. Value negative space. Avoid standard Bootstrap columns.
layouts.product_grid: Grid with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Images max-h-[80vh]. Avoid equal squares if possible, mix aspect ratios or use offset alignment.
layouts.product_detail: Zoom in. Large, immersive product imagery taking 50-60% of the screen width. Sticky product info on the right.
layouts.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, tight gaps (gap-6). Modular, rearrangeable widgets. Left sidebar navigation.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 for sections. p-8 inside bordered containers.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none) or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm) to match the editorial brutalist vibe. Hover: invert colors or translate-y-1 with subtle shadow. No pill shapes for this theme.
components.cards: Storefront: Cardless, just images and typography. Dashboard: 1px border border-black/10, no heavy shadows. Flat solid backgrounds.
components.inputs: Shadcn default but highly customized. 1px solid border, focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-black. rounded-none.
components.navigation: Sticky, 'Crystal' Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) for storefront. Solid dark for dashboard sidebar.
components.overlays: Max overlay opacity: bg-black/30. If you can't clearly identify what's in the hero image, the overlay is too heavy.
components.toasts: Sonner (bottom-right), styled to match minimalist aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate strokes, border-border. Use Grid Borders (Technical Look) for feature/data sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows, but kept extremely minimal. Prefer sharp contrasts over blurry shadows.
visual_enhancers.motion: Framer Motion. Hover micro-interactions (e.g., image zoom in slightly on hover). Smooth entrance animations.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlays to kill the digital flatness on large image blocks.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Check hover/focus states to guarantee text remains visible.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements. focus:ring-black.

media.image_style: High editorial, minimal background distraction, lifestyle contextualization.
media.aspect_ratio: Product lists: 3:4 (Portrait) for fashion, 1:1 or 4:3 for electronics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for storefront hero and creative layouts to achieve asymmetry. Do not force creative sections into rigid Shadcn Cards.
For interactive components (forms, dialogs, dropdowns, calendars, tables), heavily rely on Shadcn, but customize them by setting rounded-none and applying stark borders.
DO NOT use pure HTML for dropdowns or date pickers. Use Shadcn DropdownMenu and Calendar.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
In the admin dashboard, prioritize data clarity. Go cardless or use subtle borders. Do not use teal green (#1B93A4) for dashboards.
DO NOT use a completely transparent header. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70.
Utilize Framer Motion for entrance animations, hover states, and smooth transitions.
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto' for storefront headings.
Always set explicit hover and focus text colors (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white).
Use actual image URLs provided. Never use dummy image placeholders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (crisp rectangular for this theme) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
